title: Global Profiling of c-Jun and JunB transcription factor binding sites in an ALK+ ALCL cell line
authors: Zuoqiao Wu; Mary Nicoll; Farynna Loubich Facundo; Jingxi Zhang; Robert J. Ingham
one_liner_zh: 该文通过ChIP-seq全局鉴定ALK+ ALCL细胞系中c-Jun/JunB转录因子结合位点，属纯实验测序研究，无AI或物理模拟方法，且未涉及三维互作建模，仅部分涉及TF-DNA结合位点鉴定，与本课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Anaplastic lymphoma kinase-positive, anaplastic large cell lymphoma (ALK+ ALCL) is a T cell lymphoma which features translocations or inversion involving the ALK tyrosine kinase gene, and results in oncogenic fusion proteins (e.g. NPM-ALK). The elevated expression and/or activation of activator protein-1 (AP-1) transcription factors, c-Jun and JunB, is another molecular feature of ALK+ ALCL. c-Jun/JunB transcriptional targets are important in the pathobiology of this lymphoma, and several are also therapeutic targets. To better understand c-Jun/JunB function in ALK+ ALCL, we performed chromatin immunoprecipitation–sequencing experiments in the Karpas 299 ALK+ ALCL cell line to comprehensively identify sites bound by these transcription factors. We identified 13,083 c-Jun and 40,369 JunB binding sites, and ∼60% of sites bound by c-Jun were shared with JunB. Many sites were associated with genes known or predicted to be important in the pathogenesis of ALK+ ALCL. Pathway enrichment analysis of genes associated with both c-Jun and JunB binding sites revealed a significant over-representation for pathways associated with cancer and cell signalling. Furthermore, we identified several c-Jun and JunB binding sites associated with the NIBAN2 / FAM129B gene. FAM129B is a PH domain-containing phosphoprotein that promotes proliferation in multiple cell types. However, while we found that FAM129B knock-down resulted in modest cell cycle alteration in most ALK+ ALCL cell lines, this did not appear to result in a significant proliferation defect. Finally, we found that inhibition of NPM-ALK and MEK/Erk signalling altered FAM129B electrophoretic mobility and decreased phosphorylation of FAM129B on serine residues known to be Erk phosphosites. In summary, this study is the first to globally profile sites bound by c-Jun/JunB in ALK+ ALCL. It reveals novel putative targets for these transcription factors in ALK+ ALCL, and identifies FAM129B as a novel phosphoprotein downstream of NPM-ALK signalling.
abstract_zh: 间变性淋巴瘤激酶阳性、间变性大细胞淋巴瘤（ALK+ ALCL）是一种T细胞淋巴瘤，其特征为涉及ALK酪氨酸激酶基因的易位或倒位，并导致致癌融合蛋白（如NPM-ALK）的产生。激活蛋白-1（AP-1）转录因子c-Jun和JunB的表达升高和/或激活增强，是ALK+ ALCL的另一个分子特征。c-Jun/JunB的转录靶标在该淋巴瘤的病理生物学中具有重要意义，其中多个靶标同时也是治疗靶点。为更深入理解c-Jun/JunB在ALK+ ALCL中的功能，我们在Karpas 299 ALK+ ALCL细胞系中进行了染色质免疫沉淀测序实验，以全面鉴定这些转录因子结合的位点。我们共鉴定出13,083个c-Jun结合位点和40,369个JunB结合位点，其中约60%的c-Jun结合位点与JunB共享。许多位点与已知或预测在ALK+ ALCL发病机制中重要的基因相关联。对与c-Jun和JunB结合位点相关的基因进行通路富集分析，结果显示与癌症和细胞信号传导相关的通路显著富集。此外，我们鉴定了与NIBAN2/FAM129B基因相关的多个c-Jun和JunB结合位点。FAM129B是一种含PH结构域的磷蛋白，可促进多种细胞类型的增殖。然而，尽管我们发现FAM129B敲低在大多数ALK+ ALCL细胞系中导致轻微的细胞周期改变，但这似乎并未引起显著的增殖缺陷。最后，我们发现抑制NPM-ALK和MEK/Erk信号通路会改变FAM129B的电泳迁移率，并降低FAM129B在已知为Erk磷酸化位点的丝氨酸残基上的磷酸化水平。总之，本研究首次在ALK+ ALCL中全局性描绘了c-Jun/JunB结合的位点图谱，揭示了这些转录因子在该淋巴瘤中的新型推定靶标，并将FAM129B鉴定为NPM-ALK信号通路下游的新型磷蛋白。
